milestones.title: Understand the current UI
acceptance_criteria: The owner can see which colors are hard-coded and which come from tokens.
Open questions about persistence are answered or turned into a stated assumption.

milestones.title: Build the theme and the plan health badge
acceptance_criteria: Light and dark render from one token set, with a manual override.
Each plan card shows progress and blocked work without opening the plan.

milestones.title: Verify the result
acceptance_criteria: Regression tests cover the token layer and the badge.
An independent audit approves the diff against the spec.

milestones.title: Close out
acceptance_criteria: Documentation and the bitácora describe what changed and what remains.

tasks.title: Inventory the color tokens and the places that hard-code colors
tasks.objective: List every token and every literal color in the plan pages.
acceptance_criteria: A table of tokens and literal colors exists in the task evidence.

complexity.justification: For inventory the color tokens and the places that hard-code colors: A read-only inventory of two files.

scope.justification: For inventory the color tokens and the places that hard-code colors: Reads two files and writes nothing.

duration.justification: For inventory the color tokens and the places that hard-code colors: Two files, one pass.

risk.justification: For inventory the color tokens and the places that hard-code colors: Nothing is modified, so nothing can regress.

coupling.justification: For inventory the color tokens and the places that hard-code colors: No other task changes these files at the same time.

confidence.justification: For inventory the color tokens and the places that hard-code colors: Both files were opened while writing this plan.

tasks.title: Research how the page can follow the system theme and keep a manual choice
tasks.objective: Decide where the owner's choice can be stored without a database.
acceptance_criteria: The note names one storage place and why, or states the assumption that replaces it.

complexity.justification: For research how the page can follow the system theme and keep a manual ch: Reading browser behavior and the server's static handler.

scope.justification: For research how the page can follow the system theme and keep a manual ch: No product file changes.

duration.justification: For research how the page can follow the system theme and keep a manual ch: A short spike.
evidence: assumption:the browser keeps a cookie or local value without server changes

risk.justification: For research how the page can follow the system theme and keep a manual ch: A wrong note only delays T5.

coupling.justification: For research how the page can follow the system theme and keep a manual ch: Independent of every other task.

confidence.justification: For research how the page can follow the system theme and keep a manual ch: The server handler was inspected but browser storage behavior is assumed.
evidence: assumption:local browser storage is available in the owner's browsers

tasks.title: Add the light and dark token layer with a manual override attribute
tasks.objective: Define one token set for both themes and let a data attribute override the system choice.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Comparable to the earlier token rewrite.
acceptance_criteria: Both themes render every page without a literal color left in the plan pages.
An explicit attribute wins over the system preference.

complexity.justification: For add the light and dark token layer with a manual override attribute: One token block plus a small selector change.

scope.justification: For add the light and dark token layer with a manual override attribute: Changes the shared stylesheet and one page module.

duration.justification: For add the light and dark token layer with a manual override attribute: Comparable to the earlier token rewrite.

risk.justification: For add the light and dark token layer with a manual override attribute: A bad token can make text unreadable on every page.

coupling.justification: For add the light and dark token layer with a manual override attribute: Every page reads the shared tokens.

confidence.justification: For add the light and dark token layer with a manual override attribute: The inventory from T1 lists exactly what has to move.

tasks.title: Show progress and blocked work on each plan card
tasks.objective: Add a compact health line to the plan cards using data the status API already returns.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Similar to adding a chip row.
acceptance_criteria: A card shows done/total tasks and the number of blocked tasks.
A plan with no tasks says so instead of showing 0/0.

complexity.justification: For show progress and blocked work on each plan card: A rendering change over existing fields.

scope.justification: For show progress and blocked work on each plan card: One page module and its test.

duration.justification: For show progress and blocked work on each plan card: Similar to adding a chip row.

risk.justification: For show progress and blocked work on each plan card: A wrong count misleads the owner about a plan.

coupling.justification: For show progress and blocked work on each plan card: Only the plans page consumes it.

confidence.justification: For show progress and blocked work on each plan card: The fields exist in the status payload.

tasks.title: Keep the owner's theme choice between sessions
tasks.objective: Store the choice in the browser and apply it before first paint, with no flash of the wrong theme.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Unknown until T2 settles where the value lives.
acceptance_criteria: Reloading keeps the chosen theme.
Without a stored choice the system theme is used.
No request carries the choice to the server.

complexity.justification: For keep the owner's theme choice between sessions: Touches rendering order, the server handler and storage.

scope.justification: For keep the owner's theme choice between sessions: Three product files across layers.

duration.justification: For keep the owner's theme choice between sessions: Unknown until T2 settles where the value lives.

risk.justification: For keep the owner's theme choice between sessions: A flash of the wrong theme or a broken first paint affects every page.

coupling.justification: For keep the owner's theme choice between sessions: Shares the token layer with T3 and the static handler.

confidence.justification: For keep the owner's theme choice between sessions: The storage place is still an assumption from T2.
evidence: assumption:browser storage works for the owner's local server origin

tasks.title: Check contrast of every badge and chip in both themes
tasks.objective: Measure text and background pairs and fix those below 4.5:1.
tasks.estimate_rationale: About fifty pairs at a minute each.
acceptance_criteria: Every text/background pair is at least 4.5:1 in both themes.

complexity.justification: For check contrast of every badge and chip in both themes: Measuring pairs and adjusting a few tokens.

scope.justification: For check contrast of every badge and chip in both themes: One stylesheet.

duration.justification: For check contrast of every badge and chip in both themes: About fifty pairs at a minute each.

risk.justification: For check contrast of every badge and chip in both themes: Low: failures only produce a report and token tweaks.

coupling.justification: For check contrast of every badge and chip in both themes: Edits the same tokens as T3, so it waits for it.

confidence.justification: For check contrast of every badge and chip in both themes: The pair count is an estimate.

tasks.title: Add regression tests for the token layer and the health line
tasks.objective: Cover the override attribute, both themes and the health line, including the empty-plan case.
acceptance_criteria: The tests fail if the override attribute stops winning.
The 0/0 case renders the empty wording.

complexity.justification: For add regression tests for the token layer and the health line: Assertions over rendered HTML.

scope.justification: For add regression tests for the token layer and the health line: One test module.

duration.justification: For add regression tests for the token layer and the health line: Matches earlier page tests.

risk.justification: For add regression tests for the token layer and the health line: Weak tests would let regressions through.

coupling.justification: For add regression tests for the token layer and the health line: Depends on T3 and T4 markup.

confidence.justification: For add regression tests for the token layer and the health line: The existing test module already renders these pages.

tasks.title: Independent audit of the M2 changes against the spec
tasks.objective: A fresh reviewer compares the whole M2 diff with the spec and standards and reports findings.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Two hours for a careful pass.
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement R1-R4 is traced to a change and a test.
Findings are fixed or recorded as proposals.

complexity.justification: For independent audit of the m2 changes against the spec: Reviews five files across layers with no shortcuts allowed.

scope.justification: For independent audit of the m2 changes against the spec: The whole feature.

duration.justification: For independent audit of the m2 changes against the spec: Two hours for a careful pass.

risk.justification: For independent audit of the m2 changes against the spec: A missed defect ships to every page.

coupling.justification: For independent audit of the m2 changes against the spec: Needs every M2 task finished.

confidence.justification: For independent audit of the m2 changes against the spec: The size of the diff is not known yet.
evidence: assumption:the M2 diff stays under 400 lines

acceptance_criteria: The documentation names the toggle, the health line and what was left out.

complexity.justification: For update the documentation and the bitácora: Prose in one reference file.

scope.justification: For update the documentation and the bitácora: One document.

duration.justification: For update the documentation and the bitácora: A short edit.

risk.justification: For update the documentation and the bitácora: Documentation only.

coupling.justification: For update the documentation and the bitácora: Written after the audit.

confidence.justification: For update the documentation and the bitácora: The reference file exists.
